Mapping in progress | Awareness

_As a user, I want to know if a map is in progress, even if I navigate away from the mapping results page, so that no matter where I am in the product, I know if I am using credits._

UI Suggestion:

We need this UI to be eye catching enough that it does help the user notice when mapping is on/off, but not so eye catching that it is distracting.

The navigation bar is present on every screen in the product, in this include;

For beta; clear text to indicate what is happening (example; Mapping in progress, Mapping not in progress) and, an icon to indicate progress (A spinner icon or similar

although this may be too distracting) OR a status (of on/off).

Post beta; consider adding a drop down from the above that shows each map in progress, with a progress % and an arrow the user can click to take them to that map.
